'''Xisha''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

During the event [[By Moon's Grace]], Xisha is a shop NPC in [[Taoyuan Vale]] for [[Fireworks Shop]].

==Shop==
{{Shop/Wrapper|currency=Shell Credit|total=50,000|vendor=Xisha|
{{Shop|Skyshaker|500|100|total=1|type=Other}}
}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Xisha}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Near Lollo Logistics office)
:'''Xisha:''' Whew... Whew... At last, time for a little break.
:{{DIcon}} Is working as a courier really that tough?
:'''Xisha:''' It's tough, yet knowing that we, Lollo Logistics, are the lifeline after all other transportation is cut off really boosts my drive.
:'''Xisha:''' Besides... my daughter Xuan Xuan is watching me, so I can't slack off.
----
;(Other locations - Near [[Huaxu Academy]], Near [[Jinzhou]] Resonance Nexus)
:'''Xisha:''' Done. This one's off. Onto the next...
:'''Xisha:''' Tiring, sure, but can't rest now... With so many paths blocked since [[the Lament]], it's on us to get these deliveries through.
:'''Xisha:''' The orders from the [[Desorock Highland]] have been piling up lately. Something might be happening on the frontline... I need to step up my game.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Event Dialogue===
====By Moon's Grace====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Xisha''': Combine the Silver Dragon with this one... and the Thunderstorm...
:'''Xisha''': Oh, Rover, it's you! Welcome! Just give me a moment to check the inventory here.
:{{DIcon}} Take your time.
::'''Xisha''': You know what, I'll sort them out later.
:{{DIcon}} So many different kinds of fireworks.
::'''Xisha''': Yep, and some experimental ones too, hehe...
:'''Xisha''': Sorry for the wait, Rover. See any fireworks you like? I've got pretty much every type here.
:'''Xisha''': Skyrockets, sparklers, smoke flares... you name it.
:'''Xisha''': Oh, I also provide recipes for making your own custom fireworks.
:'''Xisha''': Who knows, maybe yours will steal the show at the Moonlit Fair!
----
:'''Xisha''': Come on up, come on in! Have a look at the fireworks!
:{{DIcon|Shop}} Open store
:;(Opens [[shop]])
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Xisha''': Hmmm... so sleepy. Eh, what's new?
::'''Xisha''': With the hours I've been pulling, it's a miracle I'm still awake. Reminds me of my Lollo Logistics days.
::'''Xisha''': I promised my daughter we'd set up the firework stall at the Moonlit Fair. Gotta keep that promise.
::'''Xisha''': I'll design the patterns, and you deal with the hands-on stuff. Together, we'll create something memorable!
::'''Xisha''': All this work... Well, as long as my girl loves it, it's no trouble at all.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
